org.portico.utils.classpath

Class Classpath

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.utils.classpath.Classpath

  • public class Classpath
extends Object
    This class contains a bunch of utility methods for querying and managing the system classpath. Methods for extending it and finding out what locations are on the search path are provided. As instances of this class all work on the same underlying data (the system classpath), changes made through one instance will be reflected in the others.

    NOTE: This uses a dirty reflection hack to extend the system classpath.

        Throws:

      • scan

        public Set<File> scan(File location,
                      boolean recursive)
               throws ClasspathException
        This method scans the given location for jar files. Each file found will be added to the system classpath.

        If the given location is a file, it will be added to the path and the method will exit

        If the given location is a directory, it will be searched for all containing .jar and .zip files, with each being added to the classpath. Should the recursive flag be set to true, all contained subdirectories will also be scanned.

        Should any of the files or directories not be readable, they will be ignored.

        Parameters:
        location - The location to scan for jar/zip files
        recursive - Should all the directories contained within the given directory also be scanned themselves
        Returns:
        The set of all files found and added to the classpath
        Throws:
        ClasspathException
